status: Windows metadata-only baseline; not a full product budget pass

before.scope: release metadata-only core child process; diagnostic parent excluded; no GUI/GPU/audio/image bytes
before.peak_semantics: sampled peaks may miss transient allocations; os_peak_* are cumulative process-lifetime high water marks
before.cpu_semantics: GetProcessTimes deltas include diagnostic bookkeeping; percentage is one logical core; wall latency uses child Instant

after.scope: release metadata-only core child process; diagnostic parent excluded; no GUI/GPU/audio/image bytes
after.peak_semantics: sampled peaks may miss transient allocations; os_peak_* are cumulative process-lifetime high water marks
after.cpu_semantics: GetProcessTimes deltas include diagnostic bookkeeping; percentage is one logical core; wall latency uses child Instant

limitations: Metadata-only BlobRef leases; no resident image bytes, actual hash verification, GUI, GPU or audio
Two sequential processes per profile/build; before and after source/executable identities stay separate
Timing from child Instant; Windows CPU accounting is quantized and includes diagnostic work, especially imprecise for minimal profile
Sampled memory may miss transients; cumulative OS peaks are separate; release retention is allocator/OS cost, not proof of a leak
Large profile is 100 documents of 50 layers each; a single 5000-layer document is not represented
No Linux/macOS or remote CI measurements
